lines.text: It’s project time! Make one or two characters dance in ScratchJr when the green flag is pressed, using a repeat block for the dance moves.
Make one or two characters dance.
Put up, down, right, left inside a repeat block to make a dance.
Give every dancer a green flag.
Press the flag and they all dance.
Tap the green sound button and add a pop or your own recorded sound.
Dance to the star: up, down, right — 3 times! Use 🔁.
Hop, hop, hop — what a dance!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
